sn22.27:1.19: yāvatā viññāṇassa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho || || 17

sn22.27:1.23: Yāva kīvañcāham bhikkhave imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ || gha ||
sn22.27:1.26: Akuppā me cetovimutti || ayam antimā jāti || natthidāni punabbhavo ti || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra ||
